candidate_center.construction_method: one point Newton correction b_C=-P*F(a_C,0), serialized from 192-bit Arb midpoint enclosure

candidate_slope.definition: S approx -P*J_a at theta_C; exact inverse is not used as a theorem decision

affine_correlated_centered_taylor.method: single alpha affine form theta_C+(T*v+N*S)*alpha with explicit residual decomposition

constant_leaf_centered_natural_interval.method: natural interval evaluation of P*F(a,b_C) over the first leaf

direct_zero_centered_natural_interval.method: natural interval evaluation of P*F(a,0) over the first leaf

taylor_decomposition.derivative_source: B*DR3 from frozen v0.7.4 Arb response_jacobian_and_gradient
taylor_decomposition.domain: first leaf alpha interval; eta domains listed per candidate radius
